# Cliniq Labs and Logiq Labs

Independent apps by Hassan Chizari, previously presented as Random Mini Apps.

## Brands

- [Cliniq Labs](https://randomminiapps.github.io/cliniq-labs/): Healthcare education and reading accessibility, with research separately labelled.
- [Logiq Labs](https://randomminiapps.github.io/logiq-labs/): Digital confidence and everyday tools.

## Apps

- [Car HUD Display](https://randomminiapps.github.io/logiq-labs/car-hud-display/): Car HUD Display turns your iPhone into a professional heads-up display with GPS speed, trip widgets, mirror mode, weather, compass and smart brightness. Status: available.
- [Cardiac Aftercare](https://randomminiapps.github.io/cliniq-labs/cardiac-aftercare/): Cardiac Aftercare is an invite-only prototype for cardiac specialists and junior doctors: governed RAG, deterministic clinical triage, and on-device LLM development for UK/NHS post-discharge recovery questions. Not for patient or public distribution. Status: research.
- [ClinSpeak OET](https://randomminiapps.github.io/cliniq-labs/clinspeak-oet/): ClinSpeak OET helps nurses practise OET-style speaking with timed role plays, transcript replay and structured feedback on clarity, empathy, organisation and language. Status: available.
- [BoomColor](https://randomminiapps.github.io/logiq-labs/coloring-book/): BoomColor is a relaxing coloring book app with 700+ pages, tap-to-fill painting, creative fill effects, daily challenges, photo imports and a browsable gallery for iPhone and iPad. Status: available.
- [Dyslexia Reading Lens](https://randomminiapps.github.io/cliniq-labs/dyslexia-reading-lens/): Dyslexia Reading Lens is a calm reading workspace for iPhone: dyslexia-friendly text, read-aloud with highlighting, document scanning, and AI simplify and summary tools. Status: available.
- [FractureFlow AI](https://randomminiapps.github.io/cliniq-labs/fractureflow-ai/): FractureFlow AI is an invite-only research MVP for MIU, ED and Virtual Fracture Clinic clinicians: safety-before-RAG decision support, governed UK evidence retrieval, evaluation harnesses, and X-ray detection research. Not for patient or public distribution. Status: research.
- [HotspotCheck](https://randomminiapps.github.io/logiq-labs/hotspot-check/): HotspotCheck helps you understand whether the Wi-Fi you are using looks safe, risky, or worth avoiding. Check visible network risks, gateway warnings, and public hotspot safety indicators before sensitive logins. Status: available.
- [Keepie Yuppie](https://randomminiapps.github.io/logiq-labs/keepie-yuppie/): Keepie Yuppie is a physics-based ball juggling game with 99 levels, weather effects, obstacles, Game Center, survival mode and premium unlimited lives. Status: available.
- [Lighting Check](https://randomminiapps.github.io/logiq-labs/lighting-check/): Lighting Check estimates lux with your iPhone camera, compares practical guidance, calibrates against a trusted meter, saves on-device audits, and exports PDF or CSV reports. Status: available.
- [MedViva Coach](https://randomminiapps.github.io/cliniq-labs/medviva-coach/): MedViva Coach helps A-level students and aspiring medical students practise medicine mock interviews aloud and receive structured AI feedback on communication, confidence, reflection and answer structure. Status: available.
- [MsgSecret](https://randomminiapps.github.io/logiq-labs/msgsecret/): MsgSecret helps you encode and decode messages with classic cipher methods, then share ciphertext through email, SMS, WhatsApp, social apps and more. Status: available.
- [Natural Text](https://randomminiapps.github.io/logiq-labs/natural-text/): Natural Text encrypts your text into natural-looking text using a secret key, with support for multiple languages and sharing through email, SMS and messaging apps. Status: available.
- [NMC OSCE AI Coach](https://randomminiapps.github.io/cliniq-labs/nmc-osce-coach/): NMC OSCE AI Coach helps internationally educated nurses practise OSCE-style stations aloud with timed scenarios, AI patient voice, checklist feedback and exam plans. Status: available.
- [UCAT Sprint Coach](https://randomminiapps.github.io/cliniq-labs/ucat-sprint-coach/): UCAT Sprint Coach is a privacy-first UCAT practice app with 1,444 original questions, timed drills, full mocks, progress analytics and study planning for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Status: upcoming.
- [ScamLens](https://randomminiapps.github.io/logiq-labs/scamlens/): ScamLens is a completely free, privacy-first scam checker for iPhone and iPad. Check links, QR codes, texts and screenshots on your device — nothing is ever uploaded. Status: upcoming.

## Important context

Educational apps do not provide official scores or guarantee outcomes. Research prototypes are invite-only and not for patient use or live care. Website practice examples are illustrations, not screenshots, live AI or official exam material. Prices and compatibility should be checked in the App Store.
